subject: self-correction-drift-detection

metrics.name: Self-correction and drift detection
drift_detection_methods: Per-cycle: compare new accuracy vs prior (alert if >2σ drop)
Per-axis: compare per-axis score vs prior (alert if >10% drop)
Per-model: compare leader identity vs prior (alert if leader changes unexpectedly)
Cross-bank: compare related axes (e.g. governance vs fairness) for consistency
auto_correction_triggers: If accuracy drops >2σ → revert to last known-good bank weight + post correction
If leader changes unexpectedly → pause + flag for owner review
If cross-bank consistency breaks → publish correction card
metrics.doctrine: Self-correction is structural, not optional. 48 corrections to date = body that publishes when it's wrong

honest_sentence: Self-correction + drift detection: per-cycle accuracy alert >2σ, per-axis >10% drop, leader change, cross-bank consistency. Auto-revert + post correction if triggered. 48 corrections + 1 retraction (DR-0007) — structural, not optional.
